notes: embedding_source names where the vectors in records.json/cases.json came from.
'hashing-stub-v1' means NO vectors are committed and the harness derives them
from the deterministic bag-of-words stub at seed time. Under that tag the hybrid
arm exercises fusion MECHANICS only — it says nothing about semantic quality,
because the stub makes vocabulary-mismatch cases near-orthogonal exactly like FTS.
To make the hybrid arm meaningful, regenerate with real vectors from the deployed
space and flip this tag to 'minilm-l6-v2-256@sentence-transformers'. See README.md.
The backend embeds nothing by design, so real vectors are always generated
out-of-band by a runner and committed as data.

version 2 (2026-08-14): grown to the parent plan's 50-case floor by 2026-08-04-memory-golden-set-grow-to-target — 24 cases/30 records -> 50 cases/64 records. Baselines are keyed to a case set: numbers recorded against version 1 are NOT comparable, both because the denominator changed and because the corpus now exceeds ARM_LIMIT so the semantic arm no longer ranks the whole corpus.

Regenerating at version 2 re-emitted the version-1 vectors with <=1.4e-07 per-component drift (cosine 1.000000000000, <5e-05 degrees) — the service no longer reproduces the 2026-08-04 floats bit-for-bit. Kept uniform on purpose: pinning the old floats would leave regenerate_vectors.py --check reporting permanent drift.
